note: Cleft palate and bifid uvula are reported in STISS cohorts but appear to be infrequent secondary features rather than common manifestations.

evidence.text: In a study identifying single-gene CNVs including PSMD12, cleft palate was documented in one patient and bifid uvula in one patient, supporting their low frequency in affected individuals.

source.title: Identification of novel candidate disease genes from de novo exonic copy number variants
source.quote: cleft palate (one patient), and bifid uvula (one patient)… PSMD12 causes a syndromic neurodevelopmental disorder.

evidence.text: Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome is characterized primarily by neurodevelopmental delay, facial dysmorphism, autoinflammation, and limb anomalies, with structural malformations showing variable expressivity across cohorts.

source.title: Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome: expanding the clinical and molecular phenotype
source.quote: The expressivity of most clinical features in STISS is highly variable. In addition to previously reported DD/ID, speech delay, cardiac and renal anomalies, we also confirmed preaxial hand abnormalities as a feature of this syndrome.
